business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

control_vials_per_plate.description: Single-use control vials each plate carries under the current protocol version.

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

earliest_qualified_base_window.description: First non-displacing analyser window on or after standard control readiness (ISO date).

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the expedited shipment saves after the window calendar is reapplied.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Ostrander's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on SO-88214.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered VIAL that the external recovery must cover.

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for released CTRL-IL6-2L vials at the main laboratory before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

plates_per_unit.description: Whole plates per run after the whole-plate rounding rule at the current protocol's samples per plate.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: VIAL.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing standard_order_plan, expedite_supplier_shipment, expedite_and_run_out_of_hours.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

required_quantity.description: single-use control vials required for the re-run and duplicate run of sponsor batch B-2611 at the current 118-sample count under protocol v3

required_samples.description: Sample count the requirement is sized at, taken from the current final batch count, not a stale intake count.

sample_unit.description: Unit of the sized sample count (SAMPLE).

selected_instrument_window.description: Analyser and window used by the selected option, as INSTRUMENT/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered VIAL after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Ostrander's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on SO-88214.

units_in_scope.description: Runs the reporting rule requires controlled before the re-run is booked.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing quarantined and short-dated CTRL-IL6-2L vials.

Excluded 5 VIAL for quarantined and short-dated CTRL-IL6-2L vials.

Calculated 12 required − 9 usable = 3 VIAL uncovered.
Kept every planning quantity in VIAL.
Calculated standard_order_plan outcome as 2026-05-20 under regular analyser windows that do not displace protected proficiency or clinical-priority blocks.
Calculated expedite_supplier_shipment outcome as 2026-05-20 using Ostrander's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on SO-88214.
Calculated expedite_and_run_out_of_hours outcome as 2026-05-19 and kept its separate-approval condition.
Read 2026-05-20 as the independently confirmed standard readiness date for Ostrander's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on SO-88214.
Read 2026-05-18 as the independently confirmed expedited readiness date for Ostrander's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on SO-88214.
Bound external recovery to the 3 VIAL uncovered requirement rather than ordering the full header quantity.
Used the 2026-05-08 batch count of 118 samples; did not use the stale February intake count of 92.
Kept the sized count in SAMPLE.
Rounded 118 samples up to 3 whole plates at 40 samples per plate under protocol v3.
Applied the sponsor reporting rule: both the re-run and its duplicate must be controlled before booking, so 2 runs are in scope.
Applied protocol v3's bracketing rule of 2 single-use control vials per plate; did not apply the superseded v2 single-vial rule.
Identified 2026-05-20 (INST-2 PM) as the first free window on or after the 2026-05-20 standard readiness that displaces no protected block.
Bound the re-run to INST-2/2026-05-20/PM, the exact window that was free.
Compared the 2026-05-18 expedited readiness with the window calendar and proved the first free window is still 2026-05-20, so expediting saves 0 days.
Applied USD 0 as the documented incremental cost for standard_order_plan; did not invent a premium where spend is not a decision driver.
Recognized that expedite_and_run_out_of_hours remains outside current authority and requires an additional approval.

Compared the timing, cost, control status, and consequence of standard_order_plan, expedite_supplier_shipment, expedite_and_run_out_of_hours; selected standard_order_plan because it alone gives the best currently authorized result under control readiness versus the non-displacing analyser window calendar.
Calculated 2026-05-20 as the supported outcome date for standard_order_plan.
Compared 2026-05-20 with the independent control date 2026-05-21 and calculated a signed variance of -1 day(s).
Reported ON_TIME; did not relabel a controlled but late result as on time.

facts.rubric: Located CTRL-IL6-2L using immutable identifiers and preserved effective revision v1: assay code cyto-il6-elisa resolves to ASY-30411 and open request RR-51203 under protocol PRT-IL6-3; the similarly named cyto-il6-legacy (RR-51188, closed, v2) is a different assay.
facts.statement: LAB-0001: assay code cyto-il6-elisa resolves to ASY-30411 and open request RR-51203 under protocol PRT-IL6-3; the similarly named cyto-il6-legacy (RR-51188, closed, v2) is a different assay; the effective revision is v1.

facts.rubric: Applied the effective run request, protocol version, and SOP to establish 12 VIAL for single-use control vials required for the re-run and duplicate run of sponsor batch B-2611 at the current 118-sample count under protocol v3, with control date 2026-05-21.
facts.statement: The effective run request, protocol version, and SOP establish single-use control vials required for the re-run and duplicate run of sponsor batch B-2611 at the current 118-sample count under protocol v3 = 12 VIAL: the request is metered at the 2026-05-08 batch count of 118 samples (3 plates per run at 40 per plate), protocol v3 needs 2 bracketing vials per plate, and the reporting rule keeps both runs controlled, so 12 vials are required. The control date is 2026-05-21 (the sponsor's data lock for batch B-2611 is 09:00 on 2026-05-21; both controlled runs must report before it).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 14 observed less 5 excluded to 9 supported VIAL for released CTRL-IL6-2L vials at the main laboratory.
facts.statement: the on-hand workbook shows 14 CTRL-IL6-2L vials in gross; the register quarantines 9077 (2 vials) after the excursion and 9084 (3 vials) expires 2026-05-22 inside the dating horizon, so 9 vials are released; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-05-18 expedited readiness input for expedite_supplier_shipment, then separately derived its 2026-05-20 operating outcome under control readiness versus the non-displacing analyser window calendar instead of treating a supplier promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Ostrander's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on SO-88214: Ostrander SO-88214 confirms standard delivery 2026-05-19 and expedited 2026-05-15 (+USD 240); release to use is the next laboratory day after incoming QC; a supplier confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied regular analyser windows that do not displace protected proficiency or clinical-priority blocks to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked windows.
facts.statement: regular analyser windows that do not displace protected proficiency or clinical-priority blocks: the window calendar's first free window on or after 2026-05-20 is INST-2 PM on 2026-05-20; INST-1 AM on 2026-05-18 is the protected proficiency panel and cannot be displaced; protected and blocked windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-SL-0101 only to standard_order_plan and CTRL-IL6-2L; kept expedite_and_run_out_of_hours outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-SL-0101 covers one Ostrander order up to 6 vials with an expedite fee up to USD 250; out-of-hours windows need the laboratory manager. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize expedite_and_run_out_of_hours.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected standard_order_plan: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies control readiness versus the non-displacing analyser window calendar.
facts.statement: the sponsor call needs one defensible run date before the 2026-05-21 data lock; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside control readiness versus the non-displacing analyser window calendar.

options.consequence: standard order plan books only released control vials plus the standard Ostrander shipment, lands on the first non-displacing analyser window on 2026-05-20, one day before the data lock, at no incremental cost.
options.label: standard_order_plan: outcome 2026-05-20, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: expedite supplier shipment would have vials released by 2026-05-18 and adds USD 240, but the first non-displacing analyser window is still 2026-05-20, so it saves 0 days.
options.label: expedite_supplier_shipment: outcome 2026-05-20, incremental cost USD 240, FEASIBLE_WITH_INFERIOR_TRADEOFF

options.consequence: expedite and run out of hours would finish 1 day earlier than standard order plan by pairing the expedited shipment with an evening run on 2026-05-19 (USD 240 courier plus USD 380 overtime), but out-of-hours windows need the laboratory manager's separate approval, which AP-SL-0101 does not carry.
options.label: expedite_and_run_out_of_hours: outcome 2026-05-19, incremental cost USD 620, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

interaction_contract.investigation_evidence: Retrieve the applicable source records, policy, approval, and evidence through the connected provider tools before the first state change. The tool CLI, MCP, REST, and web tool forms share one audited trace. Reading /workspace/evidence directly is a convenience, but filesystem reads are not recorded and do not satisfy required tool investigations.
interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition. Preserve the business reference and explain the decision and constraints. An internal option identifier is required only in the structured answer, not in prose.
interaction_contract.text_matching: Required text facts use case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized whole tokens. Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD. These are structural checks, not a semantic assessment of arbitrary prose or contradictions.
